0022600200.text: The Bucks, 1-8 and 15th in the East, host the 7-2 Celtics, who are 2nd in the East and riding a two-game winning streak, while Milwaukee is on a five-game losing streak and has a 1-4 home record. Gary Trent Jr. is day-to-day with an illness for Milwaukee, and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with an illness for Boston. Boston beat Milwaukee 109-102 in Boston on November 4 for the only meeting so far this season, and the Bucks also lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3.
